---
title: "Data Cleaning: Missing Death Date and Last Follow-Up Date"
author: "Data Quality Check"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, comment = "")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "~/R")
options(repos = c(CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"))

# Load shared setup
source("ctDNA_Research_Questions_Shared_Setup.R")

# Load required libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(readxl)
  library(janitor)
  library(lubridate)
  library(knitr)
  library(kableExtra)
})
```

```{r load_data, include=FALSE}
# Load data with survival information
data_list <- load_minimal_data(include_survival = TRUE)
dat_combined <- data_list$dat_combined
```

```{r identify_date_columns, include=FALSE}
# Identify death date columns
death_date_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^death_date$|death.*date$", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                       !str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("cause|reason|method", ignore_case = TRUE))]

# Identify last follow-up date columns
survival_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("last.*follow.*up.*date|follow.*up.*date", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                     !str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("period|duration|length|years|months", ignore_case = TRUE))]

cat("**Date Column Identification:**\n")
cat("- Death date columns found:", length(death_date_cols), "\n")
if (length(death_date_cols) > 0) {
  cat("  Column names:", paste(death_date_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
cat("- Last follow-up date columns found:", length(survival_cols), "\n")
if (length(survival_cols) > 0) {
  cat("  Column names:", paste(survival_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
cat("\n")
```

```{r extract_dates, include=FALSE}
# Extract death date and last follow-up date for each patient
patient_dates <- dat_combined %>%
  select(patient_id, all_of(c(death_date_cols, survival_cols))) %>%
  mutate(
    # Parse death date (use first available column)
    death_date = if (length(death_date_cols) > 0) {
      as_date_safe(.data[[death_date_cols[1]]])
    } else {
      as.Date(NA)
    },
    # Parse last follow-up date (use first available column)
    last_fu_date = if (length(survival_cols) > 0) {
      as_date_safe(.data[[survival_cols[1]]])
    } else {
      as.Date(NA)
    },
    # Create flags for missing dates
    missing_death_date = is.na(death_date),
    missing_last_fu_date = is.na(last_fu_date),
    # Combined flag: missing both
    missing_both = missing_death_date & missing_last_fu_date,
    # Missing either
    missing_either = missing_death_date | missing_last_fu_date
  ) %>%
  select(patient_id, death_date, last_fu_date, missing_death_date, missing_last_fu_date, missing_both, missing_either)
```

```{r summary_statistics}
cat("## Summary of Missing Date Data\n\n")

total_patients <- nrow(patient_dates)
missing_death <- sum(patient_dates$missing_death_date, na.rm = TRUE)
missing_fu <- sum(patient_dates$missing_last_fu_date, na.rm = TRUE)
missing_both <- sum(patient_dates$missing_both, na.rm = TRUE)
missing_either <- sum(patient_dates$missing_either, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("**Overall Summary:**\n")
cat("- Total patients in dataset:", total_patients, "\n")
cat("- Patients missing death date:", missing_death, "(", round(missing_death/total_patients*100, 1), "%)\n")
cat("- Patients missing last follow-up date:", missing_fu, "(", round(missing_fu/total_patients*100, 1), "%)\n")
cat("- Patients missing both dates:", missing_both, "(", round(missing_both/total_patients*100, 1), "%)\n")
cat("- Patients missing either date:", missing_either, "(", round(missing_either/total_patients*100, 1), "%)\n")
cat("- Patients with both dates available:", total_patients - missing_either, "(", round((total_patients - missing_either)/total_patients*100, 1), "%)\n\n")
```

```{r patients_missing_death_date}
cat("## Patients Missing Death Date\n\n")

patients_missing_death <- patient_dates %>%
  filter(missing_death_date) %>%
  arrange(patient_id) %>%
  select(patient_id, death_date, last_fu_date) %>%
  mutate(
    death_date = ifelse(is.na(death_date), "Missing", as.character(death_date)),
    last_fu_date = ifelse(is.na(last_fu_date), "Missing", as.character(last_fu_date))
  )

if (nrow(patients_missing_death) > 0) {
  cat("**Total patients missing death date:**", nrow(patients_missing_death), "\n\n")
  
  patients_missing_death %>%
    kable(caption = "Patients Missing Death Date", align = c("l", "c", "c")) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), 
                  full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
    column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
    print()
} else {
  cat("**All patients have death date recorded.**\n\n")
}
```

```{r patients_missing_last_fu_date}
cat("## Patients Missing Last Follow-Up Date\n\n")

patients_missing_fu <- patient_dates %>%
  filter(missing_last_fu_date) %>%
  arrange(patient_id) %>%
  select(patient_id, death_date, last_fu_date) %>%
  mutate(
    death_date = ifelse(is.na(death_date), "Missing", as.character(death_date)),
    last_fu_date = ifelse(is.na(last_fu_date), "Missing", as.character(last_fu_date))
  )

if (nrow(patients_missing_fu) > 0) {
  cat("**Total patients missing last follow-up date:**", nrow(patients_missing_fu), "\n\n")
  
  patients_missing_fu %>%
    kable(caption = "Patients Missing Last Follow-Up Date", align = c("l", "c", "c")) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), 
                  full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
    column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
    print()
} else {
  cat("**All patients have last follow-up date recorded.**\n\n")
}
```

```{r patients_missing_both}
cat("## Patients Missing Both Death Date and Last Follow-Up Date\n\n")

patients_missing_both <- patient_dates %>%
  filter(missing_both) %>%
  arrange(patient_id) %>%
  select(patient_id, death_date, last_fu_date) %>%
  mutate(
    death_date = "Missing",
    last_fu_date = "Missing"
  )

if (nrow(patients_missing_both) > 0) {
  cat("**Total patients missing both dates:**", nrow(patients_missing_both), "\n\n")
  cat("**Note:** These patients have no death date AND no last follow-up date recorded. This may indicate incomplete follow-up data.\n\n")
  
  patients_missing_both %>%
    kable(caption = "Patients Missing Both Death Date and Last Follow-Up Date", align = c("l", "c", "c")) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), 
                  full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
    column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
    print()
} else {
  cat("**All patients have at least one date (death date or last follow-up date) recorded.**\n\n")
}
```

```{r patients_missing_either}
cat("## All Patients Missing Either Death Date or Last Follow-Up Date\n\n")

patients_missing_either <- patient_dates %>%
  filter(missing_either) %>%
  arrange(patient_id) %>%
  mutate(
    death_date_display = ifelse(is.na(death_date), "Missing", as.character(death_date)),
    last_fu_date_display = ifelse(is.na(last_fu_date), "Missing", as.character(last_fu_date)),
    missing_type = case_when(
      missing_both ~ "Both Missing",
      missing_death_date ~ "Missing Death Date Only",
      missing_last_fu_date ~ "Missing Last FU Date Only",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(patient_id, death_date_display, last_fu_date_display, missing_type) %>%
  rename(
    `Patient ID` = patient_id,
    `Death Date` = death_date_display,
    `Last Follow-Up Date` = last_fu_date_display,
    `Missing Type` = missing_type
  )

if (nrow(patients_missing_either) > 0) {
  cat("**Total patients missing at least one date:**", nrow(patients_missing_either), "\n\n")
  
  patients_missing_either %>%
    kable(caption = "All Patients Missing Either Death Date or Last Follow-Up Date", align = c("l", "c", "c", "l")) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), 
                  full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
    column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
    column_spec(4, italic = TRUE) %>%
    scroll_box(height = "600px") %>%
    print()
} else {
  cat("**All patients have both death date and last follow-up date recorded.**\n\n")
}
```

```{r export_missing_patients, include=FALSE}
# Export list of patients with missing dates to CSV for further review
if (exists("patients_missing_either") && nrow(patients_missing_either) > 0) {
  write.csv(patients_missing_either, 
            file = "patients_missing_dates.csv", 
            row.names = FALSE)
  cat("**Note:** List of patients with missing dates has been exported to 'patients_missing_dates.csv' for further review.\n\n")
}
```
